mapping_semantics: Each item references passing tests from the listed modules. This association is evidence indexing, not proof that every frozen acceptance condition was independently signed off. Cases may overlap between criteria; they are never added to the full-suite total.

checks.limits: 可做模块证据；需当前组合根合法 payload 和冻结 packet 结果
规则未知/拒绝有测试；生产事实 provider 仍未验收
能力缺失和 simulation 语义需用当前组合根复验
test executor 闭环；需保留 A/B scope 与 strategy root 产物
unknown cancel 与新 attempt 有回归；宿主真实取消属于 G3
当前为本地 Python 探测；无宿主 provider 矩阵

申请不自动批准；需公开入口回执和 approval revision
仅 synthetic interaction proof；真实宿主身份属于 G3/G4

snapshot digest 测试；需当前 manifest 产物摘要
本轮已重跑；观察失败、目标改变与重启后对账不可重写 sink

需第三轮明确 temp DB/WAL/SHM、产物与失败归档路径；缓存和运行数据库不得入库
